law_text: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway until permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
